answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 31496 Country: Pakistan Title: Is there a zakat on diamond or other precious stones? Question: Is there a zakat on diamond or other precious stones? Answer ID: 31496 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 699/504/L=1432) There is no zakah on diamond or precious stones provided they are not for business: لا زكوة فى اللآلى والجواهر إلا أن تكون للتجارة (در مختار مع شامي: 3ظ194) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
